highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 adds Graphite bindings and async pixel reads alongside the Skia m152 engine update.
highlights_body: It also adds the Vulkan Silk.NET package, native symbols for Apple platforms, Nano Server font support, and multiple lifecycle and performance fixes.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled renderer to Skia m152 with subsequent upstream servicing and stability fixes.
Adds bindings for Skia's Graphite GPU backend on Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn, enabling applications to adopt the newer rendering architecture.
SKImage and SKSurface now provide backend-neutral asynchronous RequestReadPixels APIs for non-blocking pixel retrieval.
Keeps pixel sources alive for SKPixmap subset and With operations, and releases raster allocations when SKImage creation fails.
Roots regions used by span iterators and disposes the non-memory-backed stream path used to create HarfBuzz blobs.
Avoids an unnecessary SKData save copy, feature-array copying during HarfBuzz shaping, and avoidable string and uniform lookup allocations.
SKRuntimeEffectUniforms.Reset now disposes its previous uniform buffer before replacing it.
Adds the SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package, produces Apple native symbol packages, and uses FreeType for Nano Server font support.

contributor_summaries.jeffska: Added FreeType-backed font support for Nano Server
contributor_summaries.mmitche: Improved Windows native build setup by initializing the MSVC environment once
contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Added Graphite GPU backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn

preview_summaries.v4.152.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 introduced the m152 engine update, Graphite bindings, async pixel readback, and reliability fixes across native object lifetimes.
preview_summaries.v4.152.0-rc.1.26426.14: Release Candidate 1 added native symbol and package refinements while preparing the m152 line for stable release.

harfbuzz_summary: Improves HarfBuzz shaping performance by avoiding a defensive feature-array copy, fixes non-memory stream cleanup, and reduces tag formatting allocations.

v4.152.0-preview.1.1.headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 Preview 1 introduces Graphite bindings and the Skia m152 engine update.
v4.152.0-preview.1.1.body: It also adds asynchronous pixel readback and fixes native object lifetime handling.

v4.152.0-rc.1.26426.14.headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 Release Candidate 1 prepares Graphite and m152 support for stable release.
v4.152.0-rc.1.26426.14.body: It includes native package and symbol refinements.

v4.152.0.headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 is the stable release with Graphite bindings and the Skia m152 renderer.
v4.152.0.body: It includes asynchronous pixel readback, platform package additions, and lifecycle improvements.
